Camila — thanks for the follow-up and the questionnaire. Quick answers from our side and a couple clarifications: 

- SOC 2: We require a vendor to have SOC 2 Type II or be in scope to complete within 6 months with evidence of controls. Can you confirm Redwood's current SOC 2 posture and whether you can share your SOC 2 report or an SOC 2 readiness statement?
- GDPR/HIPAA: We are HIPAA-covered for PHI. We need to understand whether Redwood is willing to sign a BAA and how PHI flows are controlled.
- Logs: ideal output is JSON with timestamps in ISO8601 and a CSV option for quick ingestion. We also need a tamper-evident / WORM-like export for certain admin events. For retention, some legal reqs are 7 years for audit records.

We’re available Tue (12/8) 10–12 PST for a technical call. I’ve CC’d security@medestate.com (our security ops) — they’ll own the questionnaire.

Hi all — quick answers and attachments (see activity-log-sample.csv):

- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified (cert effective 2026-03-01). We can share a redacted SOC 2 report under NDA / existing mutual NDA clauses. I’ve attached a one-page status note PDF to the drive link included in metadata.
- BAA/HIPAA: We execute a standard BAA for customers processing PHI. Our legal team has a BAA template; if MedEstate has specific liability edits we can review.
- Exports: we support streaming JSON and batch CSV exports for admin events and API request logs. Each record includes ISO8601 timestamps, actor_id, org_id, request_id, endpoint, status_code, and payload metadata.
- Immutability: activity records are written to an append-only store backed by an object-store with write-once retention policies; exported files include a SHA256 manifest and optional PGP-signed bundle for tamper-evidence. We also support lifecycle locks for up to X years per contract.
- Retention: default retention for activity logs is 90 days in hot tier; customers can configure archival retention (WORM-enabled) up to 10 years in our dedicated/private offerings. For hosted customers requiring 7+ years, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment + contractual retention settings.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Camila — please confirm Tue 12/08 10:00–10:30 PST for a technical review with Rishi + our infra engineer.
2) Alex/security — if you agree, we will (a) share a redacted SOC2 under NDA, (b) provide the sample CSV (attached) and a short immutability diagram, and (c) follow up with BAA template.

If you need the sample JSON as well I can ask Rishi to attach it in the next email.

Regards,
